text.p: The firmer trend in the recent of European and gains by the escudo were helping to lift bonds in early trade and traders saw the spread with the 10-year cash Bund narrowing towards 60 basis points.
The yield gap was 63 percent in early trade, unchanged on Wednesday's close.
"Europe is well-supported, Italy is very strong and we are following behind. The 10-year spread could hit the 'magic figure' of 60 basis points today," said one fixed-income trader.
But breaking below 60 would depend on the performance of the other peripheries, particularly the Italian BTP, he added.

Another trader said that after the recent gains, the moment had come for caution, particularly as French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin is to give a keynote policy speech to parliament today, beginning at 1300 GMT.
The strengthening of the escudo against the mark, helped by the EDP privatisation, and the slight easing in money market instruments could induce a modest steepening of the curve, traders added.
